designationHistory.name: Appert Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 8110 setting apart about 1,163 acres in Emmons County, North Dakota, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: APP transcribes the Federal Register text, so those two are one text; the FWS 1991 narrative independently gives May 10, 1939 (it calls it the purchase date).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 8110
